title: SKEL-01 Panel fixes: late final ack anchor (M1), signer flood caps (M2), agent_id↔connection check (S3), unprivileged shared uid (S2)
outcome: Honest runs always verify with --head; a flooding rogue cannot bloat gateway memory or stall ticks
acceptance: test: late witness ack → anchor equals newest verified checkpoint; verify --head OK
test: signer flood → refusals counted not stored, per-socket per-tick line cap, connection closed; tick time bounded
test: envelope agent_id ≠ connection's agent → deny bad_sig on that conn
--shared-uid runs agents under one unprivileged uid, never 0
